answer: Each epoch the seed scatters every key into an unseen cohort, so no operator can choose whom its aliases sit beside. Emission unlocks only when a cohort tally matches the median across cohorts; any cohort whose internal transfers loop back on themselves is dissolved and its bonds swept into a common vault. Splitting one agent into a thousand through a prism of keys therefore buys nothing: aliases land among honest strangers, each pays a full deposit, and self-dealing rings get detected and burned. A raven cannot fake a flock, only rent one at rising cost.
